News Date : 02 Dec 2024News ReportDate: December 2, 2024The Telangana Public Service Commission (TPSC) has honored Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Technology (MGIT), Gandipet, Ranga Reddy, with aLetter of Commendationfor its exceptional efforts in conducting theGroup-1 Services Mains Examinationsheld from October 21 to 27, 2024.In the commendation, TPSC praised MGIT for its meticulous planning, seamless execution, and strict adherence to the processes required for the examinations. The letter acknowledged the contributions of the management, director, principal, faculty, and staff in ensuring the examinations were conducted with devotion, integrity, and team spirit.The conducive environment and facilities provided by MGIT elevated the trust of the candidates, contributing to the smooth conduct of the examinations. TPSC expressed gratitude for the institution’s commitment to excellence and acknowledged the critical role MGIT played in ensuring the success of this significant event.Key Highlights from the Letter:Recognition of MGIT’smeticulous planningandscrupulous execution.Acknowledgment of theseamless performanceof all staff involved.Commendation for creating asupportive and conducive environmentfor candidates.Dr. E. Naveen Nicolas, IAS, Secretary of TPSC, and Dr. M. Mahender Reddy, IPS (Retd), Chairman of TPSC, conveyed their appreciation and expressed hope for similar support in future competitive examinations as per the Telangana Government’s job calendar.This recognition underscores MGIT’s dedication to societal service and its commitment to fostering excellence in every task it undertakes. MGIT is proud to contribute to initiatives that support the aspirations of candidates across Telangana.

Date: December 2, 2024
The Telangana Public Service Commission (TPSC) has honored Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Technology (MGIT), Gandipet, Ranga Reddy, with aLetter of Commendationfor its exceptional efforts in conducting theGroup-1 Services Mains Examinationsheld from October 21 to 27, 2024.
In the commendation, TPSC praised MGIT for its meticulous planning, seamless execution, and strict adherence to the processes required for the examinations. The letter acknowledged the contributions of the management, director, principal, faculty, and staff in ensuring the examinations were conducted with devotion, integrity, and team spirit.
The conducive environment and facilities provided by MGIT elevated the trust of the candidates, contributing to the smooth conduct of the examinations. TPSC expressed gratitude for the institution’s commitment to excellence and acknowledged the critical role MGIT played in ensuring the success of this significant event.
Key Highlights from the Letter:
- Recognition of MGIT’smeticulous planningandscrupulous execution.
- Acknowledgment of theseamless performanceof all staff involved.
- Commendation for creating asupportive and conducive environmentfor candidates.
Dr. E. Naveen Nicolas, IAS, Secretary of TPSC, and Dr. M. Mahender Reddy, IPS (Retd), Chairman of TPSC, conveyed their appreciation and expressed hope for similar support in future competitive examinations as per the Telangana Government’s job calendar.
This recognition underscores MGIT’s dedication to societal service and its commitment to fostering excellence in every task it undertakes. MGIT is proud to contribute to initiatives that support the aspirations of candidates across Telangana.
